items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I used to be a buddy of Sam Langford's.

ctx.x: Did you ever know anything about Jack Johnson?

Jack Johnson? Jack Johnson I never met, but he was -- up in 1914, he was up there in Chelsea, Massachusetts. But I didn't see him, see. And I think Sam Langford -- see, I used to be a buddy of Sam Langford's.
